title: L23 — read-only Paper continuous tick × S7 settling boundary (DEV source-only)
body:
## Goal

L23 bridges L22's sealed first-Action S7/S16 originals and the S-owned Paper S50 `S50_DEV_WAIT_BEGIN/TICK` callback format as a **read-only DEV source-shape diagnostic**. Existing S branch is [Draft PR #545](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/pull/545), physical boundary [#627](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/issues/627); L Lane L22 source [#639](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/issues/639).

### Current boundary

The L22 real Run1 physically measured 0.240460m post-S16 movement and 6 move events, then three quiet samples. S Paper callback source can produce 8 consecutive `World.getFullTime` tick rows with position and cumulative movement counters; this is **one callback per tick**, not a complete all-tick input-idle census. S49's vanilla run1 has **no Paper original**; the L23 unit tests must use a plainly synthetic Paper candidate with the *unchanged* real L22 S7 original.

The Paper console's `marker_id=action_id-session_id` is operator-supplied and cannot establish a server-effective S15 clear tick, full input idle, independently authenticated World identity, or S7/Paper sampling simultaneity. Similar coordinates only establish geometric compatibility, not a common-clock causal join. User-supplied standing L Lane DEV grant remains in force, but the available GitHub-only execution environment cannot launch the user's local Minecraft, therefore new live evidence needs LocalCodex on the user host.

### L23 initial implementation

- [x] Isolated branch `dev/l23-paper-settling-boundary-20261031` from immutable L22 HEAD `451270faa1281889494f933a5eda33a71e88834f`.
- [x] Read-only source checker consumes exact sealed S7, S16, pre-World Goal plan, and bounded Paper text, validating one 8-tick contiguous callback bracket, counters/geometry and marker.
- [x] Distinguish `PAPER_8_QUIET_SAMPLES_ONLY` from `PAPER_SAMPLED_ACTIVITY`, preserve hashes and data lineage.
- [x] Reject malformed/foreign/partial sources without modifying archived L22 original, and keep Goal/L10/S10/S11/P1 all unqualified.
- [x] Exact-head Python focused CI and repository contracts: [Actions #41174355128](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/actions/runs/41174355128), **38 PASS / 0 FAIL**, Ruff, compileall, repository contracts PASS.
- [ ] S-owned Paper original in **fresh isolated disposable L Lane World**, with preregistered explicit marker before snapshot and same-run S7 raw originals, owner-isolated scope (do not edit S Draft).
- [ ] Determine a causal common anchor for effective control clear and server tick (cannot derive from `time_of_day`/two matching coordinates/operator marker alone).
- [ ] Only then consider any stronger physical input-idle/Goal qualifications with separate source-owner gates.

## Classification

`DEV_ONLY / PAPER_SAMPLED_CALLBACK_READBACK / STABILITY_NOT_ATTESTED / CLOCK_ALIGNMENT_NOT_ATTESTED / GOAL_UNDETERMINED / L10_S10_S11_0 / QUALIFICATION_NO_GO / SCIENCE_NOT_RUN`

No user or repo evidence outside L22 is rewritten. S/P1/R/V owner contracts remain untouched.

## Verification, 2026-10-31

Branch exact HEAD: `f5a0d41675e89a1675af6648d4f1358613bd6908`. [Actions #41174355128](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/actions/runs/41174355128) **SUCCESS** on that head (Python 3.12 38/38, Ruff, Python syntax and repository contracts). All Paper rows in tests are explicitly synthetic; the sealed L22 real S7/S16 originals are unchanged. Code/CI do not instantiate Paper, Java or Node. Fresh local World needs user-host LocalCodex or an authorized runtime with installed Java/Node/Paper; the ChatGPT GitHub-only runner cannot operate the user's Windows/WSL processes.

## 2026-10-31 — Prospective isolated Paper/S49 DEV runtime opt-in

Implementation branch `dev/l23-paper-settling-boundary-20261031` now includes `l23_paper_live_assets.py` and opt-in S49 `--l23-paper-*` flags. Assets are six paired explicit path/SHA pins (server JAR, unchanged S-owned plugin JAR, active config). Checks occur before Java, stage only a fresh temporary World, with S owner code untouched. **Active Paper plugin modifies metabolism**, so this is an explicitly labeled DEV intervention, not a passive observer.

S49 invokes and checks an original Paper PRE_FORWARD marker before its original single Action issuer. After true S15 clear/S16 OUTCOME, it checks POST_CLEAR and WAIT_BEGIN, then executes normal L22 bounded settling/Goal sampling on the existing S7 reader. After Java shutdown, L23 audits complete Paper console original vs sealed S7/S16. Current source gate requires two ordered Paper phases and 8 consecutive Paper callbacks. No inference of server-effective input clear tick, true whole-tick input idle, or L10/P1/R acceptance.

Related [design / local-run asset arguments](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/blob/dev/l23-paper-settling-boundary-20261031/docs/l-lane-l23-paper-s7-settling-20261031.md). Focused CI at code HEAD `a3e717a44f9eb49e68c14717aae073781f2abb02` [#41174630003](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/actions/runs/41174630003) **89 PASS**, Ruff/compile/contracts PASS. Later cleanup commits adjust byte bounds and runtime missing-marker FAIL classification; final exact-HEAD CI must be checked independently. **No new physical Paper World launched from ChatGPT GitHub-only environment.** The user has standing L-lane disposable real-World DEV grant and LocalCodex on WSL may execute under that scope.

## Final exact-head offline verification

`e8cbe9fdad91f855c93966b380bc239b7c9e3495`: [Actions #41174708239](https://github.com/rinsakamo/relay-self/actions/runs/41174708239) **SUCCESS**, Python 3.12 **89 PASS / 0 FAIL**, Ruff, compileall and repository contracts PASS. Tests include active pinned Paper preflight, bounds, console marker ack/reject, phase order, immutable L22 S7 regression and L21 native observer tests. This exact HEAD contains the post-start missing-marker failure status fix. No new Java/Node/Minecraft process ran in CI; real Paper source and independent full input-idle remain not attested. Next LocalCodex task is fresh disposable Paper DEV with preregistered asset/profile SHA and readback.
